question: In March 2023, a stadium was named after which the following female hockey players?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rani Rampal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coach and field hockey player **Rani Rampal is Indian.
 
• She was the **youngest player** on the national squad that competed in the 2010 World Cup, having turned 15 years old. 
 
• Rani Rampal is a **renowned Indian female hockey player** who has led the Indian women's hockey team to various victories, including the **silver medal** at the** 2018 Asian Games** and the qualification for the** 2020 Tokyo Olympics**.
 
• A stadium was named after Rani Rampal's name in **March 2023**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poonam Rani** is also an **Indian female hockey player.**

 
 
• **​**It is claimed that after witnessing India win the **gold medal **at the** 2002 Commonwealth Games** in **Manchester, England,** she became encouraged to play hockey.
 
 
 
• **Sushila Chanu** is another I**ndian female hockey player.**
 
 
• **​**She has **150 international caps** to her name and was the captain of the Indian national team in the past.
 
 
 
• **Navjot Kaur** is also an** Indian female hockey player.**
 
 
• **​**She is competing in the **Summer Olympics **for India's women's hockey squad.
